group: Linking nage-waza, applied in the same direction
opening: Tori applies tsurikomi-goshi, and applies harai-goshi at the point where uke puts his right foot out to the side to defend.
ukeDefends: Uke defends against tori's tsurikomi-goshi by putting out his right foot.
ukemi: Uke takes a mae-mawari-ukemi (forward rolling breakfall) in time with the harai-goshi.

group: Linking nage-waza, applied in the same direction
opening: Tori applies uchi-mata, and applies tai-otoshi at the point where uke defends.
ukeDefends: Uke defends against tori's uchi-mata by supporting himself on his right foot.
ukemi: Uke takes a yoko-ukemi (side breakfall) in time with the tai-otoshi.

group: Linking nage-waza, applied in different directions
opening: Tori applies tsurikomi-goshi, and applies o-uchi-gari at the point where uke drops his hips to defend.
ukeDefends: Uke defends against tori's tsurikomi-goshi by dropping his hips.
ukemi: Uke takes an ushiro-ukemi (rear breakfall) in time with the o-uchi-gari.

group: Linking nage-waza, applied in different directions
opening: Tori applies o-uchi-gari, and applies seoi-nage at the point where uke steps back and pushes back at him.
ukeDefends: Uke defends against tori's o-uchi-gari by stepping back, and pushes back.
ukemi: Uke takes a mae-mawari-ukemi (forward rolling breakfall) in time with the seoi-nage.

group: Linking nage-waza, applied in different directions
opening: Tori applies uchi-mata, and applies o-uchi-gari at the point where uke plants himself and defends.
ukeDefends: Uke defends against tori's uchi-mata by dropping his hips.
ukemi: Uke takes an ushiro-ukemi (rear breakfall) in time with the o-uchi-gari.

opening: Tori counters uke's o-uchi-gari and applies o-uchi-gaeshi (major inner reap counter).
ukemi: Uke takes a yoko-ukemi (side breakfall) in time with the o-uchi-gaeshi.

opening: Tori evades uke's o-uchi-gari and applies tai-otoshi.
ukemi: Uke takes a yoko-ukemi (side breakfall) in time with the tai-otoshi.

opening: When uke tries to turn onto his front, tori links into yoko-shiho-gatame.
When uke pushes at the shoulder and tries to escape, tori links into kami-shiho-gatame.

group: Varying katame-waza: escaping into your own hold
opening: Tori grips uke's back, turns him over towards the head, and holds him with kami-shiho-gatame.

group: Varying katame-waza: escaping into your own hold
opening: Tori turns uke over to the left and holds him with yoko-shiho-gatame.
After throwing with o-soto-gari, tori does not let go of the hikite (pulling hand) and links into kesa-gatame.
After throwing with ko-uchi-gari, tori moves his feet, settles at uke's side and links into yoko-shiho-gatame.
After throwing with uchi-mata, tori does not let go of the hikite (pulling hand) and links into kesa-gatame.
note: (Note) Kabai-te (protecting hand): after the throw, support your own body with your hand so that your body weight does not come directly onto the opponent, and hold him down while protecting him.
